attributes.powers:
For your combat check, recharge this card and discard a spell to roll your Strength or Melee die + 2d12. If you aren't proficient with weapons, the difficulty of this check is increased by 4.

Reveal this card to add 2 to an Intelligence check. You may use another item on this check.
